يضطرب (form VIII)
# يَضْطَرِبُ (yaḍṭaribu) /jadˤ.tˤa.ri.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِضْطَرَبَ (iḍṭaraba)
# يَضْطَرِبَ (yaḍṭariba) /jadˤ.tˤa.ri.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَرَبَ (iḍṭaraba)
# يَضْطَرِبْ (yaḍṭarib) /jadˤ.tˤa.rib/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِضْطَرَبَ (iḍṭaraba)
